en: The Philippine flag features 8 sun rays representing the first 8 provinces that revolted against Spain, which is double the 4 quarters of a basketball game.
Jose Rizal wrote 2 famous novels in just 3 years, which is faster than the 4 years it takes to complete a standard college bachelor's degree.
A Philippine President serves a single 6-year term, which is exactly twice as long as the 3-year term of a local mayor.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, but only 2 are official, meaning just 1 percent of its languages hold national government status.
T'boli weavers spend up to 6 months creating one T'nalak cloth, taking twice as long as a regular 3-month school semester.
The annual Sinulog Festival features over 100 dance contingents and draws 2 million visitors, which is 20 times larger than a 100,000-seat mega stadium.
Scientist Fe del Mundo invented a bamboo incubator costing one-fiftieth of standard electric models, saving rural hospitals thousands of pesos per unit.
The Philippines endured 333 years of Spanish rule, which is more than five times the maximum 6-year term of a modern Philippine President.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 members, which is exactly double the 12 votes needed to convict an impeached official.
National Artist Napoleon Abueva carved over 300 sculptures, including a 9-foot-tall aluminum piece that is taller than a standard 7-foot door.
Filipinos can vote at age 18, which is 3 years earlier than the age 21 minimum required to run for the Senate.
Traditional Bayanihan involved 20 to 30 neighbors carrying a nipa hut, requiring as many people as half of a standard 40-student classroom.
